bgExistingRuleDomain.message: The domain "$1" already has the following parsing rules. Compare them against the current page structure and determine whether the existing selectors are still valid:

bgMergePrinciple1.message: 1. If the existing selectors are still valid and match stably on the current page, keep them

bgMergePrinciple2.message: 2. If the current page structure has changed (different class names or DOM levels), replace them with new selectors

bgMergePrinciple3.message: 3. If the existing selectors are too broad (e.g. only using "div"), optimize them with more precise selectors

bgMergePrinciple4.message: 4. Type indicator keywords and type text keywords should be merged and deduplicated with the existing values, keeping the valid ones and adding newly discovered ones

bgMergePrinciple5.message: 5. The returned selectors should be the complete merged and optimized result, not an incremental change
